feedback.problem:
Given that
$X=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 10 & 6 \\ 0 & 8 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]$,
which of the following elementary row operations makes ${a}_{13}=0?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation 

$$
{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+(-2){R}_{2}.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}X & =[\begin{aligned}-8 & 10 & 6 \\ 0 & 8 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+(-2)\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-8 & -6 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+(-2){R}_{2}.
$$
